# Ownership, dialect, and lifecycle dispositions (issue #503).
#
# Test grouping: test-owned sources never enter the generated library.
# `*_test.*` files are test-owned; library imports index only non-test
# headers and sources contribute no identity.
# Assembly: assembly sources are undiscovered and stay handwritten
# (`.s`, `.S`, `.asm` outside `.c`/`.cc`/`.cpp`/`.cxx` plus
# `.h`/`.hh`/`.hpp`/`.hxx`).
# Modules and PCH: named C++ modules, header units and PCH have no complete
# generation route and stay handwritten; compiler flags as complete support
# stays rejected.
# Union: preprocessor-derived platform selections are not the approved
# Go-only generation exception; literal references under `#ifdef` still
# contribute the deduplicated union with no `select()`.
# Names: basename-derived names normalize deterministically and collisions
# fail with every claimant; no affix is invented.
# Lifecycle: stale generated targets clean through normal merge with keep
# protection; deleting a BUILD file stays rejected.

test-owned sources never enter the generated library
assembly sources are undiscovered and stay handwritten
named C++ modules, header units and PCH have no complete generation route and stay handwritten
compiler flags as complete support rejected
preprocessor-derived platform selections rejected
basename-derived names normalize deterministically and collisions fail with every claimant
stale generated targets clean through normal merge with keep protection
deleting a BUILD file rejected
loose generation rejected
log parsing rejected
a replacement C++ preprocessor rejected
unknown angle includes may disappear rejected
missing module mappings can warn and omit edges rejected
ambiguity can select a first candidate rejected
